_readme: Which folder in incoming-models/ is the 3D source for each dish id. Dishes not listed use the folder with the same name. Read by the Phase 2 pipeline.

steak-main.why: The 'tomahawk-steak' scan is the same geometry as the old ribeye model (100% vertex match) with 2048px textures instead of 512px. Owner confirmed it is the Premium Ribeye Steak; tomahawk removed from dishes.csv until it has its own scan.

bz-chicken-pizza.why: Pitch placeholder: an AI-generated model (Tripo) of Baraza's chicken pizza, supplied by the owner as pizza+3d+model+baraza.usdz (72 MB, 1.95M triangles). Pre-processed with scripts/prep-usdz.mjs to 40k triangles. Replace with the real scan after the pitch.
